Predicates:
ArtificiallySelected(x) ::: x is artificially selected.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
Resembles(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
ExtinctAnimal(x) ::: x is an extinct animal.
Premises:
BreedingBack(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x are animals bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x are animals.
Aurochs(x) ::: x are animals.
Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct ::: ∃x (BreedingBack(x) ∧ ∃y (Aurochs(y) ∧ Resembles(x, y)))  
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificiallySelected(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
